name: Memory Export and Erasure
description: Export memories in standard formats. Erase memories completely with cascading link cleanup. Supports GDPR-style erasure requests with audit trail.
purpose: Fulfill data portability and right-to-erasure requirements by providing clean export in standard formats and complete erasure with cascading cleanup of links, references, and derived data.
acceptanceCriteria: Export by scope: memory, bank, project, organization level
Export includes provenance and metadata, not just content
Erasure removes memory and all its links, references, and derived data
Cascading erasure respects reference boundaries — does not delete referenced entities
Erasure produces an audit record: what was deleted, when, by whom
Erasure is reversible within a configurable grace period
rollback_strategy: Restore from soft-delete graveyard; rebuild erased links
recovery_strategy: Restore from grace-period backup; replay erasure journal for audit
